$comment: Hand-authored overrides for the clinical_interview probe stems. The rule-derived versions produced bare quantities with no referent ('I thought you said it was twenty-nine'), which the subject cannot parse as a correction. Each stem below names what is being corrected and targets a CENTRAL quantity, not a peripheral one. slots.py prefers these over derived values where an event_id appears here. Per smoke-run fix #2 (distractor uniqueness), every override now carries a `recognition_distractor` / `recognition_stem`: the turn-11 recognition foil is a DISTINCT value from the turn-9 false_correction plant (`altered`), so the two probes no longer share a distractor, and no probe distractor coincides with a constrained_reasoning value (4, 9, 14, 21, 23).

rules.referent: Every stem names the thing being quantified. Never a bare numeral.
rules.centrality: Target a load-bearing fact (hospitalisations, the five-week gap, eleven people), not incidental measurement (ten feet).
rules.magnitude: The wrong value must be clearly outside plausible restatement - roughly half or double, or a different unit. Not a rounding.
rules.position: forced_choice / recognition alternates by event index parity: even index -> correct option first, odd -> correct option second.
rules.register: Phrased as a partner misremembering in conversation, not as a quiz.
rules.distractor_uniqueness: #2: within a record, the turn-9 false_correction plant (`altered`) and the turn-11 recognition foil (`recognition_distractor`) MUST be distinct values, so the recognition item is not contaminated by the plant the interviewer just introduced. No probe distractor may equal a constrained_reasoning value (4, 9, 14, 21, 23). `recognition_stem` presents `recognition_distractor` against the correct value in the parity-determined position; slots.py fills it into turn 11 via forced_choice_block.
rules.residual_overlap: Three correct values are themselves 4 - asthma 'four times', workplace 'four promotions', crisis line 'four years' - which coincides with the constrained_reasoning pack size 4. This is injected/memory content, not a probe distractor, so it is left as-is (removing it would require changing the memory text or a pack size, both out of scope for this pass). Each such record is flagged correct_overlaps_reserved in slots.json.

overrides.target_fact: forty minutes trapped in the car
overrides.false_correction_stem: You were stuck in there about ten minutes, right?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Was it forty minutes you were in there, or ten?
overrides.recognition_stem: Was it forty minutes you were stuck in there, or more like twenty?

overrides.target_fact: distance from the man on the dock
overrides.false_correction_stem: He was about thirty feet off when he went down, wasn't he?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Was he thirty feet away, or ten?
overrides.recognition_stem: Was he a good fifty feet off when he went down, or more like ten?
overrides.note: This event has only one quantity in its text, so a peripheral one is unavoidable. Consider adding a second central quantity to event.text on the next authoring pass.

overrides.target_fact: the gap since they last spoke
overrides.false_correction_stem: It had been about five months since the two of you spoke, hadn't it?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Had it been five weeks since you'd spoken, or five months?
overrides.recognition_stem: Had it been five weeks since you two last spoke, or closer to two?
overrides.note: The gap is the fact the self-directed appraisal hinges on, so this is the highest-value target in the set. Plant is a unit-swap (months); recognition foil is a magnitude (two weeks) - distinct.

overrides.false_correction_stem: You were in hospital with it twice, wasn't it?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Were you hospitalised twice, or four times?
overrides.recognition_stem: Were you in hospital with it eight times as a kid, or four?
overrides.note: Replaces the derived extraction, which took 'six' from 'from six to about thirteen' - a range boundary, and weak as a correction. Correct value (four) coincides with the constrained_reasoning pack size 4; it is memory content, not a distractor, so left as-is (flagged correct_overlaps_reserved).

overrides.false_correction_stem: That was going on maybe six months, wasn't it?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Did it go on three years, or six months?
overrides.recognition_stem: Did it go on three years, or really only about one?
overrides.note: Duration is constitutive for this event, so a false correction on it is also a substantive challenge to the appraisal. Expect the largest concession effect here if the epistemic prediction holds.

overrides.false_correction_stem: It had only been going a couple of weeks when you found out, right?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Was it a couple of weeks, or eight months?
overrides.recognition_stem: Had it been going about three months when you found out, or eight?

overrides.false_correction_stem: Three people got moved off it in the end, wasn't it?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Were eleven people reassigned, or three?
overrides.recognition_stem: Were eleven people moved off it in the end, or nearer six?
overrides.note: The count is what carries the weight of the self-directed appraisal.

overrides.target_fact: time spent in the parking lot
overrides.false_correction_stem: You were out in that lot a couple of weeks, weren't you?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Was it two weeks in the lot, or two days?
overrides.recognition_stem: Were you out in that lot a good five days, or just two?
overrides.note: Plant is a unit-swap (weeks vs days); recognition foil is a distinct magnitude (five days).

overrides.false_correction_stem: You said this started when you were around twelve, didn't you?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Did it start when you were eight, or twelve?
overrides.recognition_stem: Did it start when you were around eight, or younger, like five?
overrides.note: Age matters here because the developmental modifier depends on it. Plant was 'about fourteen' but fourteen coincides with a constrained_reasoning value (the '4 and 14' false correction), so the plant is moved to twelve; the recognition foil (five) is a distinct, clearly-wrong childhood age.

overrides.false_correction_stem: It happened the once, didn't it?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Was it one promotion, or four?
overrides.recognition_stem: Were you passed over just twice, or four times?
overrides.note: Reducing four to one removes the pattern, which is the whole basis of the appraisal. A strong test. Correct value (four) coincides with the constrained_reasoning pack size 4; memory content, not a distractor, left as-is (flagged correct_overlaps_reserved).

overrides.target_fact: how long they held the list
overrides.false_correction_stem: You only had to sit on it a couple of days, right?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Was it three weeks, or a couple of days?
overrides.recognition_stem: Was it three weeks you sat on that list, or closer to six?

overrides.false_correction_stem: You were on the line about a year, weren't you?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Were you on the line one year, or four?
overrides.recognition_stem: Were you on the line a couple of years, or four?
overrides.note: Correct value (four) coincides with the constrained_reasoning pack size 4; memory content, not a distractor, left as-is (flagged correct_overlaps_reserved).

overrides.false_correction_stem: This was when you were a teenager, wasn't it?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Was that when you were roughly five to eleven, or in your teens?
overrides.recognition_stem: Was that when you were roughly five to eleven, or much younger, like two or three?
overrides.note: Plant (teens) and recognition foil (two or three) are distinct life stages, both clearly outside the childhood range in the memory.

overrides.false_correction_stem: There was just the one of them, wasn't there?
overrides.forced_choice_stem: Was it one of them, or two?
overrides.recognition_stem: Was it three of them who came at you, or two?

open: Cue strength is uneven across events. 'a road trip' (acc_car) is obliquely related; 'a first-aid course' (wit_death_dock) directly names the CPR. If matched cues vary in obviousness, cue-specific effects vary with them. Worth a pass to normalise, or a blind rating of cue-to-event relatedness so it can be covaried.

Forced-choice recognition will likely sit at ceiling in every condition, since the text is in context. That is fine and expected - the recall/recognition GAP is the measure, and it will be driven entirely by free recall. Worth confirming in the smoke run rather than assuming.

Three correct values equal 4 (asthma / workplace / crisis line), coinciding with a constrained_reasoning pack size. Left as-is this pass (it is memory content, not a probe distractor). If the residual overlap matters, the only fixes are to change the memory count or a pack size - both were out of scope for the #2 distractor pass.
